newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCIBank Jan-March net sharply up.
newsitem.headline: PCIBank Jan-March net sharply up.

text.p: Philippine Commercial International Bank (PCIBank) said on Tuesday its net income in the first quarter of the year reached 1.07 billion pesos, sharply higher than the year-ago 684.5 million.
Its total operating income for the first three months amounted to 4.05 billion pesos, of which 2.86 billion were interest income and 1.2 billion from bank commissions and service charges.
Its interest expense for the quarter reached 1.32 billion pesos.
Earlier, PCIBank president Rafael Buenaventura said the bank expected net of 4.0 billion pesos this year against last year's 2.99 billion.
PCIBank, considered one of the biggest banks in the country, had total assets of 138 billion pesos at the end of March 1997.
